info.name: Open311 GeoReport Request Requests.{response Format} API

params.name: service_request_id
params.description: To call multiple Service Requests at once, multiple service_request_id can be declared; comma delimited.This overrides all other arguments.

params.name: service_code
params.description: Specify the service type by calling the unique ID of the service_code.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Earliest datetime to include in search. When provided with end_date, allows one to search for requests which have a requested_datetime that matches a given range, but may not span more than 90 days.

params.name: end_date
params.description: Latest datetime to include in search. When provided with start_date, allows one to search for requests which have a requested_datetime that matches a given range, but may not span more than 90 days.

params.name: status
params.description: Allows one to search for requests which have a specific status. This defaults to all statuses; can be declared multiple times, comma delimited.

items.docs: Query the current status of multiple requests.

params.name: attribute
params.description: array of key/value responses based on Service Definitions.

items.docs: Submit a new request for with specific details of a single service. Must provide a location via lat/long or address_string or address_id
